lead: The blank opens the sentence and a subject follows, with options like Should, Had, Were, If, Unless. Or the other half of the sentence contains would or could have.
空格在句首，後面接主詞，選項像 Should、Had、Were、If、Unless。或是句子的另一半有 would、could have。
steps: If the blank opens the sentence and a subject follows, test the inverted forms: Should, Had, Were.
空格在句首、後面接主詞時，先想倒裝形式：Should、Had、Were。
Read the verb after the subject: base form, past participle, or to + verb.
看主詞後面的動詞：原形、過去分詞，還是 to + 動詞。
Match it with the other clause: would + base verb, would have + past participle, or a request.
和另一半句子配對：would + 原形、would have + 過去分詞，或一個請求句。

head: Basic if-patterns
基本 if 句型
body: Unreal present: if + past, would + base verb, with were for every subject in formal English. Unreal past: if + had + past participle, would have + past participle.
與現在事實相反：if + 過去式，主句 would + 原形，正式英文中 be 動詞一律用 were。與過去事實相反：if + had + 過去分詞，主句 would have + 過去分詞。
ex: If I were in charge, I would hire more staff.
如果我是負責人，我會多聘一些人。
If we had known about the delay, we would have changed the schedule.
如果我們早知道會延誤，就會改行程了。

head: Should + subject + base verb
Should 加主詞加原形
body: Should you have … means 'if you happen to have …'. if is dropped and should moves to the front. A base verb follows the subject. Business letters use it often.
Should you have … 等於 if you happen to have …，省略 if，把 should 移到句首，主詞後面接原形。商業書信常用。
ex: Should you have any questions, please contact our support team.
如有任何問題，請聯絡我們的客服團隊。
Should the shipment arrive late, notify the warehouse manager.
萬一貨物延遲抵達，請通知倉庫經理。

head: Had + subject + past participle
Had 加主詞加過去分詞
body: Same meaning as if + had + past participle: an unreal past. The other clause uses would have + past participle.
等於 if + had + 過去分詞，表示與過去事實相反。另一半用 would have + 過去分詞。
ex: Had we received the order earlier, we would have shipped it on time.
如果我們早點收到訂單，就能準時出貨了。
Had the client approved the design, the team would have started work in May.
如果客戶核准了設計，團隊五月就開工了。

head: Were + subject + to + verb
Were 加主詞加 to + 動詞
body: Same meaning as if + subject + were to + verb. It describes an unlikely or purely imagined future in a formal tone. The other clause uses would.
等於 if + 主詞 + were to + 動詞，表示可能性很低或純屬想像的未來，語氣正式。另一半用 would。
ex: Were the company to expand into Europe, it would need more engineers.
如果公司要擴展到歐洲，就需要更多工程師。
Were the vendor to raise its prices, we would look for another supplier.
萬一供應商調漲價格，我們就會另找供應商。

head: Without, but for, otherwise
Without、but for、otherwise 表示「如果沒有」
body: These words carry the 'if' meaning themselves. The other clause uses would or could have.
這幾個字本身就帶有「如果」的意思。另一半句子用 would 或 could have。
ex: Without your help, we could not have finished the project.
沒有你的幫忙，我們不可能完成這個計畫。
We left early; otherwise, we would have missed the train.
我們提早出發，否則就趕不上火車了。

head: wish, as if, it's time
wish、as if、it's time 後的動詞形式
body: After wish and unreal as if, the verb steps back one tense: past for the present. It's time + past means the moment to act has come.
wish 和表示不符事實的 as if 後面，動詞往過去退一格：現在的事用過去式。It's time 加過去式，表示現在該做這件事了。
ex: I wish I had more time to prepare for the presentation.
真希望我有更多時間準備簡報。
He talks as if he were the CEO.
他講話的樣子好像他是執行長一樣。
It's time we updated the company website.
我們該更新公司網站了。

head: Negative word first, then inversion
否定詞在句首，後面倒裝
body: Only after, Not until, Rarely, Seldom, Never, Under no circumstances at the start force the main clause to invert: the auxiliary goes before the subject.
Only after、Not until、Rarely、Seldom、Never、Under no circumstances 放在句首時，主句要倒裝：助動詞放到主詞前面。
ex: Only after the contract is signed will we begin production.
合約簽訂之後，我們才會開始生產。
Not until the report was published did the public learn of the problem.
直到報告發表，大眾才知道這個問題。
Rarely have we received so many positive comments.
我們很少收到這麼多正面的評價。

pairs.right: Should you need assistance, please call us.
pairs.wrong: Should you needed assistance, please call us.
why: should is followed by the base verb, not by a past form.
should 後面接原形動詞，不接過去式。

pairs.right: Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
pairs.wrong: Had I know about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
why: Had at the start needs a past participle: known.
句首的 Had 後面要接過去分詞 known。

pairs.right: Only after the inspection will the factory reopen.
pairs.wrong: Only after the inspection the factory will reopen.
why: With Only after at the start, the main clause inverts: will the factory reopen.
Only after 放在句首，主句要倒裝成 will the factory reopen。

traps: Only before the subject does not trigger inversion: Only employees with badges may enter. Inversion follows an opening Only + time or condition phrase.
Only 直接修飾主詞時不倒裝：Only employees with badges may enter。句首是 Only + 時間或條件片語時才倒裝。
in case means 'as a precaution'; if means 'on the condition that'. Bring an umbrella in case it rains and bring an umbrella if it rains are different instructions.
in case 是「以防萬一」；if 是「如果」。Bring an umbrella in case it rains 和 bring an umbrella if it rains 是不同的指示。
Do not put if before an inverted form. Write If you should need help or Should you need help, not If should you need help.
倒裝句前面不能再加 if。要寫 If you should need help 或 Should you need help，不能寫成 If should you need help。
